name: 99223 · Spokane, WA
findings: ZIP 99223 (Spokane) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99223 (Spokane) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
